notes: PARTIAL-CONTENT FILE - READ FIRST: this is a genuine SSC CBE exam-screen export for the exact date+shift (header Exam Date 03/08/2023, SSC Question ID + one candidate's response recorded for ALL 100 questions), but the source PDF's text layer is only partially recoverable in this environment. Recovered in full: all 25 English questions (Q1 instruction line and Q5 stem line not in parsed layer - flagged in the questions; Q20 sentence tail recovered from a leaked fragment); Reasoning Q30 (number analogy), Q42 (series 8,11,22,?,50,53), Q43 (syllogism apples/oranges/bananas/mangoes - note Chinese characters in options 2-4 verbatim), Q44 (VAPORIZE), Q46 (odd number pair), Q45/Q31 stems; Quant: none fully recovered as text (Q56, Q57-DI-table, Q60-trig-equation, Q63, Q67, Q71-stem-fragments+options, Q74-DI-table recovered as fragments and attached as 'probable' per the layout convention below); General Awareness: all 25 questions are image-only (stem and options NOT RECOVERABLE) though every SSC Question ID and candidate response is recorded. Everything else is marked [NOT RECOVERABLE] and has NOT been invented, completed or paraphrased. SECTION ORDER on the CBE screen for CHSL 2023 Tier I: 1) English Language (Q.1-25), 2) General Intelligence (Q.1-25), 3) Quantitative Aptitude (Q.1-25), 4) General Awareness (Q.1-25); this file uses global numbering 1-100 in that order (English=1-25, Reasoning=26-50, Quant=51-75, GA=76-100); the original per-section SSC question_id is recorded for every question. UNATTRIBUTED FRAGMENTS (listed, NOT attached): (a) BODMAS expression '(1+5/6+7/8+11/12)÷(3/4−5/8)'; (b) trig evaluation 'sin90° (parsed "0°", sic) + cos30° − tan45° + cos80° (parsed "c80°", sic) + cot90°'; (c) option set 7/(6√3), √3/6, 7/6, 7/(2√3) with X marks on options 1-3; (d) a lone '90 cm²' option; (e) an angle option set 80°, 60°, 100°, 20°. These leaked into the Quant text layer out of sequence and their attribution cannot be established with certainty. LEAKED-FRAGMENT ATTRIBUTION CONVENTION: text-layer fragments that appear directly after a question's own Question-ID + Status block are attributed (as 'probable') to that question, because the following question in every such case carries its own complete ID + Status block; this is a layout inference, flagged per-question. CANDIDATE RESPONSES: recorded per question in answer_note as reference only; they are NOT official answers. KEY-MARK ARTIFACTS: some source tables embed check-mark / 'X' marks next to options (English Q24; Reasoning Q30, Q31, Q42, Q44; Quant Q60). These are Adda247's answer-key notation inside the export; they are UNVERIFIED against the SSC official key, so they are recorded in answer_note only and never used to set correct_answer. ANSWERS: the official CHSL 2023 answer key (final key published 19-Aug-2023 per SSC notice) is downloadable only by logged-in candidates on ssc.gov.in/ssc.nic.in with roll number + password; no machine-accessible official key was found in this environment, so every correct_answer here is null and answer_source null.
